name: Yaplet Live Chat
author: IG Services LLC

sections.description:
Yaplet is a modern live chat solution for your business. This plugin allows you to easily install the Yaplet widget on your WordPress site.

External services

This plugin uses the Yaplet SDK to provide chat functionality.

  • Yaplet SDK: Used to render the chat widget and handle user conversations.
    • Source URL: https://sdk.yaplet.com/latest/index.js
    • Data Sent: User identity (if provided), page navigation events, and chat messages.
    • Service Provider: Yaplet
    • Privacy Policy: https://yaplet.com/legal/privacy-policy
    • Terms of Service: https://yaplet.com/legal/terms-of-use
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/yaplet-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Settings->Yaplet screen to configure the plugin with your Widget ID.
sections.faq:
Where do I find my Widget ID?

You can find your Widget ID in your Yaplet Dashboard under Settings > Installation.
